b01-big-dog.observed_description: In a bright empty room with a light wooden floor and a plain pale wall a huge fawn Great Dane with a red collar sits upright beside a light-oak slatted dining chair; the top of the dog's head is clearly higher than the chair's backrest and its body is wider than the chair. One dog, one chair, a strip of window at the far left edge; no people, text or other objects.
b01-big-dog.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop (the crop loses only the tail tip): the dog reads as very big against the chair down to 180 px.

b02-big-house.observed_description: A wide two-storey pale house with a dark slate roof, a wooden front door in the middle and thirteen windows fills the whole photo width under a clear blue sky; one adult in a dark jacket and jeans stands at the door with their back to the camera and looks small against it. A lawn and a straight path in front; no cars, numbers, signs or animals.
b02-big-house.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: door, person and two rows of windows stay, and the house still reads as big at 180 px.

b03-small-house.observed_description: A tiny one-room pale plaster house with a dark tiled pitched roof, one wooden door and one small square window stands alone on a wide flat green lawn under a clear sky; one adult in a beige jacket stands at the door with their back to the camera, and the roof edge is only a little above their head. No cars, numbers, signs or animals.
b03-small-house.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the whole house and the person stay, and it reads as a small house at 180 px.

b04-new-car.observed_description: A spotless glossy dark-blue five-door hatchback is parked alone on a clean pale concrete driveway in front of a plain beige garage door, seen from the front left; bright reflections, clear headlights, shiny silver wheels, clean black tires, a blank white front plate and no badge. No people, other vehicles, text or dirt.
b04-new-car.note: Usable in 3:2 only: the car fills the photo width, so the centered 4:5 crop cuts its front and rear. Declared four_card false.

b05-new-bike.observed_description: A glossy bright-red city bike with a straight handlebar, a black saddle, bright silver rims, spokes and chain and clean black tires stands on its kickstand on clean pale paving in front of a plain cream wall, seen from the front left. No logo, basket, people or other objects.
b05-new-bike.note: Usable in 3:2 only: the centered 4:5 crop cuts the front wheel. Declared four_card false.

b06-same-bags.observed_description: Two identical medium-blue school backpacks stand upright side by side on a light wooden table in front of a plain pale wall, both facing the camera with a gap between them: same size, shape, front pocket, black zipper and grey top handle. Nothing else on the table; no labels or text.
b06-same-bags.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the two bags read as the same down to 180 px.

b07-same-chairs.observed_description: Two light-oak slatted wooden dining chairs of the same model and size stand side by side on a light wooden floor in front of a plain pale wall, turned toward each other; the left one is slightly more in shadow. A strip of window at the far left edge; no people, table, cushions or other objects.
b07-same-chairs.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the chairs read as the same model down to 180 px. They are mirrored (turned toward each other), not turned the same way as the prompt asked, and the left one is a little darker in the shade.

b08-big-red-bag.observed_description: In a bright hallway with pale stone tiles and white walls a huge, full, all-red hiking backpack with red straps stands on the floor beside a light-oak slatted dining chair; its top is far above the chair's seat and reaches the lower rail of the backrest, and it is almost as wide as the chair. One bag, one chair; no people, shoes, coats or text.
b08-big-red-bag.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: bag and chair stay whole, and the bag reads as big and red at 180 px.
